discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B010 (WDW LE 2018). 26 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed (or allowed_domains narrowed). Mainly Disney Pins Blog plus MyPinCentral and Disney Diary. Resellers (yourwdwstore, ecrater, magicalears, walmart) seen, not used. New: Animation Celebration filmstrips (Alice, Fantasia, Sleeping Beauty, Peter Pan; LE 750 $16.99), Mickey and the Beanstalk framed set (LE 150 $285), runDisney Dopey/Minnie 10K/Goofy Challenge, WDW Resorts Holiday 2018 (7 resorts, $16.99). Set data: Natural Beauty LE 1,500 $29.99, WALL-E boxed LE 500 $64.99, Neverland framed LE 500 $235, Goodbye set LE 1,250. F&G Minnie conflict resolved to 4,000. TSL opening pins are LR. No holds released. No prompt-injection seen.
